title: Beginner National Park Hikes GPX Routes, 10 Easy Trails USA, Hiking Route Guide PDF, AllTrails Gaia GPS Files, Road Trip Hiking Planner
description:
Ten easy, unforgettable national park hikes, with GPS routes you can follow on your phone, real elevation profiles, and a route guide for every trail.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 10 GPX route files, one per trail, for AllTrails, Gaia GPS, Komoot or a GPS watch
- Route guide: route map, elevation profile, trailhead logistics and tips for every trail
- Laurel Falls (Great Smoky Mountains), Emerald Lake (Rocky Mountain), Lower Yosemite Fall, Riverside Walk (Zion), Jenny Lake Loop (Grand Teton), Ocean Path (Acadia), Devils Garden to Landscape Arch (Arches), Rim Trail at Mather Point (Grand Canyon), Hurricane Hill (Olympic), Anhinga Trail (Everglades)

WHAT YOU GET
- GPX route files for AllTrails, Gaia GPS, Komoot or your GPS watch
- Route guide PDF in US Letter and A4
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Chosen for big rewards at beginner effort: no scrambling and no navigation skills needed. Download the park's offline map before you go. Trails and conditions change, so check the park's page on nps.gov. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable guides at hikesupplyco.com
